description: This file provides functions and classes for managing and inspecting XPU (likely a type of accelerator similar to GPU) memory, including memory allocation, deallocation, statistics, snapshots, and custom allocators.

classes.name: _XPUAllocator
classes.description: Wrapper class for internal XPU memory allocators.

classes.name: XPUPluggableAllocator
classes.description: Class for dynamically loaded XPU memory allocators from shared libraries.

methods.name: empty_cache
methods.description: Releases all unoccupied cached XPU memory to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: reset_peak_memory_stats
methods.description: Resets peak memory usage statistics for a device.

methods.name: reset_accumulated_memory_stats
methods.description: Resets accumulated (historical) memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: memory_stats_as_nested_dict
methods.description: Returns memory statistics as a nested dictionary.

methods.name: memory_stats
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of current memory allocator statistics.

methods.name: memory_allocated
methods.description: Returns current memory occupied by tensors in bytes.

methods.name: max_memory_allocated
methods.description: Returns peak memory occupied by tensors in bytes.

methods.name: memory_reserved
methods.description: Returns current cached memory in bytes.

methods.name: max_memory_reserved
methods.description: Returns peak cached memory in bytes.

methods.name: mem_get_info
methods.description: Returns total and free memory on the device.

methods.name: get_per_process_memory_fraction
methods.description: Retrieves the memory fraction set for the process on a device.

methods.name: set_per_process_memory_fraction
methods.description: Sets the memory fraction for the process on a device.

methods.name: memory_snapshot
methods.description: Returns detailed snapshot of memory segments managed by the allocator.

methods.name: _snapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the current XPU memory state.

methods.name: _dump_snapshot
methods.description: Saves a pickled snapshot of memory state to a file.

methods.name: _record_memory_history
methods.description: Enables recording of memory allocation and free events with stack traces.

methods.name: change_current_allocator
methods.description: Changes the active memory allocator to a custom one.
